'''Len''' (Japanese: '''コウジ''' ''Kōji'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP090|Stage Fight!]]''.

Len was a member of the [[Pokémon Showboat]] Crew along with [[Roger]], [[Kay]], and {{OBP|Anne|EP090}}. His main role in the Pokémon show was voicing {{p|Machoke}}. When {{TRT}} boarded their boat and held their Pokémon captive, he helped trick Team Rocket into believing all of the Pokémon knew how to talk.
{{-}}
